POC success metrics: 1) first-token latency <1.5s (95th) for streaming across 3 regions, 2) <3% error rate on tool-calls in end-to-end flows, 3) token cost within 30% of benchmark vs current provider, 4) integration time <3 weeks for front-end + Okta SSO + webhook tooling.

AE notes (Alex): short timeline, strong buying intent. Product lead (Rachel Kim) cares about streaming quality and hallucination rate when tool results are inconsistent. Asking for sample prompts and eval harness.

SE notes (Maya): planning 72h POC on hosted API with synthetic and real traffic. Will run streaming tests (WebSocket) + function/tool-calling to ticketing API (internal mock). Want telemetry endpoints/access to track first-token times. Recommended quantization/model variants for Dedicated discussion later.

Legal/Procurement: procurement lead (Sam Ortiz) requested Redwood security FAQ + SOC2 report and a draft contract with standard SLAs. Procurement wants residency options for EU customers — may later push for Private/VPC.
